name: Story reward: Space World conclusion
comment: Script 1068 (XX_Story Quest Reward ... Conclusion 462488). A world's last story step: a Member Super Chest and the bag of the minifigure its last story dungeon, 3310 Shadow Centurion Base (the Alien Queen), shows as the reward in its teleport window (RDB 1000644, as pocket adventures' world `minifigure`) (the user's rule 2026-10-29: 'a Member Super Chest + the minifigure associated with that dungeon's reward'; which dungeon concludes the world and that the minifigure comes as a bag are guesses, docs/TUNABLES.md).
